dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL; uses COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters typical of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - inpatient receipt comment editing subsystem
purpose.summary: ORCR0660 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that handles comment editing for inpatient (入院) receipts. It reads and processes multiple indexed receipt data files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65 and work variants) to generate or update comment records associated with medical billing receipts. The program manages various comment types including medication management, nutrition guidance, and discharge pre-consultation fees.

notable_features: 37 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
Multiple indexed files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
COPY with REPLACING to reuse record layouts under different prefixes
Large working-storage with occurrence tables for daily treatment tracking
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
35 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
246 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in Japanese comment lines. Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is 3826 lines. The // REPLACING delimiter style and ORCA project naming strongly indicate GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL target. No COMP-3 is unusual for a production system but consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA codebase style.
